tools.name: search_collections
tools.description: Search StartupMKT curated collection pages (e.g. "Top 25 AI Agents", "Startups over $10k MRR"). Returns matching collections that actually have listings, with title, URL and item count.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get the top items in one StartupMKT collection by slug (from search_collections): startup names, one-line descriptions and StartupMKT URLs.

tools.name: latest_funding
tools.description: Latest entries from StartupMKT Funding Radar — verified startup funding rounds from funding news sources, refreshed daily. Returns exactly what the current feed holds; amounts and rounds are passed through, never generated.

tools.name: startups_for_sale
tools.description: Marketplace listings currently open to acquisition on StartupMKT, with asking price where the seller published one.

tools.name: about
tools.description: What StartupMKT is, who it is for, and its key URLs.
